description: Virginia motorcycle delta: helmet law and lane rules. National riding skills stay in core_motorcycle.json.

questions.q: Who must wear a helmet on a motorcycle in Virginia?
questions.explanation: Virginia has a universal helmet law. Every rider and passenger must wear a helmet.

questions.q: What does Virginia law say about riding a motorcycle between lanes of traffic?
options: Riding between lanes of traffic is not allowed
Only lane filtering is allowed, when traffic is stopped or slow
questions.explanation: Virginia: riding between lanes of traffic is not allowed.

provenance.manual: § 46.2-857. Driving two abreast in a single lane

questions.q: What does Virginia require for a motorcycle rider's eye protection?
options: Required unless the motorcycle has a windshield
questions.explanation: Virginia: eye protection is required unless the motorcycle has a windshield.
questions.remember: Virginia eyewear: required unless there is a windshield.

provenance.manual: § 46.2-910. Motorcycle and autocycle operators to wear helmets, etc.; certain sales prohibited; penalty

questions.q: In Virginia, what is the youngest age for a motorcycle learner's permit?
questions.explanation: Virginia issues a motorcycle permit at 15½ years at the earliest.
questions.remember: Virginia motorcycle permit: 15½ years at the earliest.
